description: Write your design journal (kept with the garden, for you only). Write the whole journal once; after that update only the section that changed by naming it in `section` — never resend the rest. Answers the journal's length, not its text.

section.description: A heading's text, e.g. "Pass 2.1": its section (down to the next heading of the same or a higher level) is replaced; added at the end if missing

text.description: The whole journal, or with `section` that section's new text

name: write_journal
